notes.title: Introducing the Gal*Gun Trilogy Collection!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone![/h3]

We hope you’re enjoying the holiday season! This year, to celebrate the Steam Winter Sale, we’ve created the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/47776/The_GalGun_Trilogy_Collection/][b]Gal*Gun Trilogy Collection[/b][/url], combining [b]Gal*Gun: Double Peace[/b], [b]Gal*Gun 2[/b], and [b]Gal*Gun Returns[/b] into one irresistible package!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/47776/The_GalGun_Trilogy_Collection/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39260032/b63a37a2f0fbb538ed63912c933b3449501528f9.jpg[/img][/url]

The [b]Gal*Gun Trilogy Collection[/b] includes a [b]15% discount[/b] and is ‘complete the set’ so you can pick up any of the titles you’re missing and still receive the discount. All three titles will also be on sale from now [b]until January 2nd[/b], so it's absolutely the best time to complete your collection or, for newcomers to the series, indulge your curiosity…

It's never too late to jump into the Gal*Gun universe which is expanding into the realms of metroidvania! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2081400/Gal_Guardians_Demon_Purge/][b]Gal Guardians: Demon Purge[/b][/url] sees the Kamizono sisters as demon hunters battling through their high school which has been transformed into a demonic castle. We’ve also recently announced a sequel, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3253630/Gal_Guardians_Servants_of_the_Dark/][b]Gal Guardians: Servants of the Dark[/b][/url], which features demon sisters Kirika and Masha on a bloody quest to revive their demon lord.

Wishing you all the very best this holiday season and a wonderful new year 💞

PQube and Inti Creates

notes.title: Gal*Gun Returns Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33244416/61be2ca14c0368d0a813610f0d8dbbb9202c04db.jpg[/img]

Hey Gal*Gunners!

We’re so happy to finally release Gal*Gun Returns on Steam today! We know you’ve all been excited to play the very first game in the series. Check out our brand-new launch trailer below!

[previewyoutube=W14zUn5eSTU;full][/previewyoutube]

We will also be taking a look at Kaoruko’s route with PQube Community Manager Kiera at 16:00 GMT (08:00 PT) later today on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1425730/GalGun_Returns/]Gal*Gun Returns Store Page.[/url]

Gal*Gun Returns will be 10% off on Steam until 19th February, so now’s a great time to pick it up!

We also have the Gal*Gun series on sale right now, just in case you’re missing anything from your collection.

notes.title: Doki Doki VR DLC release! Korean and Traditional Chinese language patch!
notes.content:
Gal*Gunners rejoice!

All the cutie pies, angels, and demons you could ever hope for are here right before your eyes! Players around the world have made their voices heard, and now, the long-awaited "Doki Doki VR Mode" DLC is here! 

Every aspect of Gal*Gun 2 has been fine-tuned to run in VR! From shooting stages and Rendezvous Mode to Doki Doki Mode and everything in-between, 
 it's the complete Gal*Gun 2 experience in VR! 

Interact with your favorite characters anytime you like, from any distance you like, and from any angle! Get in close and you might just get a hug...or a slap in the face! You may even be able to see...well, ya know! 

Is your body ready to enjoy Gal*Gun 2 in virtual reality?!

On top of that, Korean and Chinese (Traditional) have been added to the in-game language options!

Bug fixes:
・An issue in outfit selection where setting glasses to "Nothing" was not properly reflected has been fixed.
・Various other issues have been fixed.

notes.title: Gal*Gun 2 Update (Build 3175118)
notes.content:
